propositions: Mutation gate hard-fails with exit code 2 when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent from a checked-out patchset tree because the change's base predates the script's introduction.
Changes based on commits older than the walking-skeleton commit (57d19254) that added scripts/mutation_gate.py receive a Verified -1 vote even though the gate cannot evaluate the change's quality.
Sibling gates (gen_env_registry and check_comment_hygiene) already implement a guard that skips cleanly with an explanatory message when their scripts are absent, but mutation gate lacks this guard.

The mutation gate must skip with exit 0 and an explanatory message when scripts/mutation_gate.py is not present in the checked-out tree, while still running the gate normally for changes that include the script.
